attempts.summary: Created an LVM logical volume (vg_data/lv_data) backed by two loop-device PVs on node1's root filesystem, mounted it at /srv/data, then grew it online from ~1.17G to ~2.34G while it stayed mounted, preserving all existing data. Configured a systemd oneshot unit (lvm-loop-setup.service) plus /etc/fstab entry so loop devices, VG activation, and the mount are re-established automatically at boot. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and health, issued systemctl reboot, polled until the node returned, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the LV was auto-remounted at /srv/data with data checksum still passing.
